title: DOW-UAP-D099, Intelligence Review of “Ghost Rocket” Incidents, 1947
doc_notes: This document is a 1947 intelligence review by the U.S. Department of War regarding the 'Ghost Rocket' phenomena in Scandinavia, noting the shift in Swedish official explanations from Soviet technology to celestial origins.

incidents.summary: Swedish Air Force pilot observed a dark, cigar-shaped object while flying over central Sweden.
incidents.quote: saw a dark, cigar-shaped object about 50 feet long and 3 feet in diameter

incidents.summary: General reports of 'Ghost Rockets' over Scandinavia, including Sweden, Finland, Denmark, and Norway.
incidents.quote: The two most common descriptions of the missiles were 'a ball of fire with a tail' and a 'shiny cigar-shaped object.'

incidents.summary: Reports of flying objects over various points in Europe and Africa.
incidents.quote: flying objects were reported over widely separate points in Europe and Africa
